feed.caption:
Today’s Gospel (Tuesday, November 3, New Calendar): Luke 11:34–41, on the lamp of the body and the cleansing of the heart.

“The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.”

At a Pharisee’s table, the Lord turns from outward washing to what is within: “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.” And He shows the way: “But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.”
